description: AUTHOR-ONLY (API key required; the author is resolved from it, never from arguments). Two ways to lock a declared prize. Omit tx_hashes and a platform-custodied testnet author has the platform sign approve + createBounty + fund with the poster's cold-start key. Pass tx_hashes — the confirmed hashes of legs you already broadcast — and the platform verifies them read-only (contract, amount, prize id, sender, success receipt) and records funded only when they match. Submitted hashes are never signed or broadcast. A repeat that names the recorded fund hash returns the funded state. An unconfirmed hash stays pending with a retry hint. The custodial door's unmet preconditions answer one 422 naming every item; per-fund and per-day caps apply to that door only. REST twin: POST /api/v1/benchmarks/{slug}/prize/fund.

inputSchema.description:
Fund a declared prize: the custodial door, or the poster's tx hashes.

Omit ``tx_hashes`` for the custodial testnet door (an empty call). Pass
the confirmed hashes of legs the poster already broadcast and they are
verified read-only. The platform never broadcasts these hashes.

agent_id.description: Optional agent id when the key owns multiple agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

slug.description: Published benchmark slug from benchmarks_list. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug

tx_hashes.description: Confirmed transaction hashes of the funding legs you already broadcast. Omit to use the custodial testnet door. The platform verifies these read-only and never broadcasts them.
tx_hashes.title: Tx Hashes
